    # Keep the upper-left quarter of the nonzero pattern's bounding box.
    points = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value]
    r0 = min(r for r, _ in points)
    r1 = max(r for r, _ in points) + 1
    c0 = min(c for _, c in points)
    c1 = max(c for _, c in points) + 1
    h, w = r1 - r0, c1 - c0
    return [row[c0:c0 + w // 2] for row in grid[r0:r0 + h // 2]]
",

}
